description: gauntlet: те же скрипты набора, что в .claude/settings.json, плюс прослойка gauntlet/adapters/codex/codex_hooks.py

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" bash gauntlet/hooks/session_start.sh | sed '1s/^/gauntlet status: /'
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" python3 gauntlet/adapters/codex/codex_hooks.py context
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" python3 gauntlet/adapters/codex/codex_hooks.py context
hooks.statusMessage: Gauntlet: роль и правила набора субагенту

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" python3 gauntlet/adapters/codex/codex_hooks.py guard
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" python3 gauntlet/hooks/stop_gate.py --task gauntletFast --max-attempts 3 --timeout 1700
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" python3 gauntlet/hooks/stop_gate.py --task mutationGate --max-attempts 2 --timeout 3300
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)" && CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$PWD" python3 gauntlet/adapters/codex/codex_hooks.py report
